test_cases.name: TC01_DeclarationSchemaAndCompactJson
test_cases.description: Verifies schemaVersion constant, compact JSON without BOM, and fixed field sequence.

test_cases.name: TC02_PolicyDeclarationRoundTrip
test_cases.description: Verifies full round-trip serialization and deserialization of typed policy declaration.

test_cases.name: TC03_DeterministicDigestAndEqualInstances
test_cases.description: Verifies identical digest for independent equal instances and reference SHA calculation.

test_cases.name: TC04_OpaqueStringsWhitespacePreservation
test_cases.description: Verifies leading, trailing, and internal whitespace in policyId and revision are preserved without Trim.

test_cases.name: TC05_OpaqueStringsUnicodeAndPunctuation
test_cases.description: Verifies lossless preservation of Unicode, quotes, backslashes, and punctuation in opaque identifiers.

test_cases.name: TC06_PackageIdsCaseNormalization
test_cases.description: Verifies invariant lowercase normalization of package IDs in declaration serialization.

test_cases.name: TC07_PermutationsDistinctDigests
test_cases.description: Verifies that isolated permutations of policyId, revision, list order, and multiplicity produce distinct digests.

test_cases.name: TC08_DigestOverloadParity
test_cases.description: Verifies all ComputePackagePolicyDigest overloads route through canonical declaration producing identical digest.

test_cases.name: TC09_PureCheckPackagePolicy_AlignedInventory_Success
test_cases.description: Verifies CheckPackagePolicy on physically aligned inventory (loadOrder 0, 1, 2) matching policy.

test_cases.name: TC10_PureCheckPackagePolicy_PhysicalPermutation_PreservesEffectiveOrder
test_cases.description: Verifies physical transport permutation with fixed loadOrders preserves effective execution sequence and matches expected policy.

test_cases.name: TC11_PureCheckPackagePolicy_CallerImmutability
test_cases.description: Verifies CheckPackagePolicy uses copied view and does NOT mutate caller's activeMods list.

test_cases.name: TC12_PureTryAdmit_PhysicalPermutation_CanonicalAdmittedContent
test_cases.description: Verifies two physically permuted valid inventories produce identical canonical admitted JSON and digest.

test_cases.name: TC13_DistinctValidExecutionOrders_MatchingDistinctPolicies
test_cases.description: Verifies equal-sized inventories declaring different execution sequences match their distinct corresponding policies.

test_cases.name: TC14_FreshOriginal_SerializeTrue_BeforeAdmission
test_cases.description: Verifies policy-bearing fresh-original manifest serializes with canonicalNormalize=true before external admission.

test_cases.name: TC15_OverloadParity_CheckAndTryAdmit
test_cases.description: Verifies all overloads of CheckPackagePolicy and TryAdmitWithPackagePolicy (Record vs Declaration) agree.

test_cases.name: TC16_ContractVersion_And_CapabilityFlag
test_cases.description: Verifies ADR-006B-v5-R12 contract version and GATE05_R12_PACKAGE_ORDER capability flag.

test_cases.name: TC17_Regression_R9_VersionMeaningSemantics
test_cases.description: Regresses R9 version meaning: modVersion null/empty values preserved without overwrite.

test_cases.name: TC18_Regression_DefFamiliesAndCanonicalSorting
test_cases.description: Regresses 8 Def families presence and canonical sorting order.
